scope: Dependency inventory only. References and modifiers are not executed hit counts. No complete combat graph or combat-return ranking certified.

verified_claims.raw_heal_formula: (caster_ATK * Param2/1000 + Param3/1000 + property_source_terms + custom_formula) before outgoing, incoming and contextual modifiers

native_audit.scope: Selected current method identities, fields and manually traced static base paths. No client loading, process attachment, live patches or complete combat-engine verification. Normalization omits branch addresses and RIP displacements; equal fingerprints alone do not validate referenced data. Base-path fingerprints additionally mask only immediate patch IDs flowing into identified IsPatched/GetPatch calls; immediate gameplay constants and memory operand widths remain significant. RIP-addressed constants require separate comparison.
